jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase .

The Card team builds Coinbase's credit and debit card products. We're rebuilding the Card app from React Native to native iOS and Android, and building every new feature natively. We're looking for a senior native engineer to lead that transition: set the architecture and patterns the team will scale on, raise our quality bar to match the best premium consumer apps, and help a team of strong React Native engineers become confident native contributors.

What you’ll do:

• Lead the architecture and execution of the Card app's rewrite from React Native to native iOS and Android, including module structure, navigation, state management, design-system integration, and testing.

• Define and champion native patterns and standards in Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose that the team can learn from and scale on.

• Build flagship card experiences natively with the polish, performance, and attention to detail of best-in-class consumer apps.

• Drive an incremental migration plan so the rewrite lands without stalling feature delivery.

• Mentor React Native engineers into confident native contributors through design reviews, pairing, and code review.

• Partner with design and product to raise the quality of the experience, not just ship the spec.

Required Skills and Experience:

• 7+ years building production native mobile apps, with deep expertise in iOS (Swift/SwiftUI) or Android (Kotlin/Jetpack Compose) and strong working knowledge of the other.

• A track record of shipping delightful, premium consumer apps known for polish, performance, and craft.

• Strong, well-reasoned views on mobile architecture and design patterns, and experience laying out an app structure a team can scale on.

• Demonstrated technical leadership: setting standards, driving large migrations or rewrites, and growing other engineers' skills.

• Experience partnering closely with design and product on consumer-facing experiences.

• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)).

$186,065 — $218,900 USD

Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

jobs.description:
Who are we?
Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.
We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.
We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.
We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!
About the Role?
Cohere’s Procurement team buys everything from pens to compute. We’re looking for a Lead, Direct Strategic Sourcing to own the categories closest to how we build: the technology, software, engineering talent and, over time, the compute that power our research and engineering teams.
Reporting to the Head of Procurement, you’ll build this pillar from the ground up. You’ll set category strategy, run our most complex and highest-stakes technology negotiations, and become a trusted commercial partner to engineering, research and infrastructure leaders. You’ll put the structure in place so these buys scale with both speed and control, and as the function grows, you’ll hire and lead a small team of specialists and analysts.
This is an opportunity for a hands-on, technically fluent sourcing leader who thrives in a high-growth environment, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and wants to shape how a frontier AI company buys the technology it runs on.

Responsibilities:

Own the engineering and R&D categories
• Own end-to-end strategic sourcing for Cohere’s engineering and R&D spend: technology licensing, OEM partnerships, engineering and IT software, developer and infrastructure tooling, and engineering staff augmentation and services.

• Build and execute multi-year category strategies grounded in spend analysis, market intelligence, and demand forecasts built with Engineering, Research and FP&A.

• Over time, extend the remit into compute (GPU capacity, cloud commitments, data center and colocation), partnering with Infrastructure, Finance and Legal on some of the largest commitments in the company.

Lead technology licensing and OEM deals
• Lead sourcing and negotiation of technology licensing and OEM agreements, including inbound licenses, third-party technology embedded in or distributed with our products, and partnerships that support customer deployments.

• Structure commercial and contractual terms (licensing models, IP and use rights, SLAs, liability, data protection, escrow and exit provisions) hand in hand with Legal, Security and Product.

Scale software and eng-related services buying
• Run RFx, benchmarking and negotiations for engineering and IT software, from early-stage tools to enterprise platforms, balancing engineering velocity with cost, risk and vendor consolidation.

• Own the renewal pipeline: anticipate renewals, right-size licenses based on usage data, and drive multi-year and commitment strategies.

• Build Cohere’s engineering staff augmentation program: preferred vendor panel, rate cards, SOW standards and guardrails for contractor classification and co-employment risk across countries.

Partner, deliver value and keep us in control
• Be the go-to commercial partner for Engineering, Product & Research, Infrastructure, IT and Security leaders, brought in at planning stage rather than at signature.

• Partner with Legal, Security/TPRM, FP&A and Accounting so every deal is compliant, budgeted, properly PO’d and correctly accounted for.

• Deliver and report measurable value: savings, cost avoidance, improved terms and risk reduction.

• Maintain audit-ready documentation and controls in line with Cohere’s procurement policy.

• Use Omnea and AI tooling, including Cohere’s own North, to automate intake, spend analysis and negotiation preparation.

• Create the playbooks for your categories and grow the team behind them: hire, coach and lead specialists and analysts as the function scales.

You may be a good fit if you have:
• 8+ years of progressive procurement or strategic sourcing experience, with significant time owning technology categories (compute, software, technology licensing, IT and engineering services), ideally in a high-growth technology company.

• A track record of negotiating complex, high-value, multi-year technology agreements, including enterprise software and technology licensing or OEM deals.

• A deep understanding of software commercial models (SaaS, usage-based, enterprise license agreements, cloud marketplace and commit structures) and the contract terms that matter in them.

• Experience sourcing engineering staff augmentation, contingent labour or IT professional services, including SOW and rate management.

• Technical fluency: you can discuss architecture, usage and roadmap trade-offs with engineers and researchers and earn their trust.

• Strong analytical skills: TCO and should-cost modelling, spend analysis and clear, data-driven recommendations.

• The ability to influence without authority and communicate crisply with senior leaders.

• A builder’s mindset: you’re comfortable creating structure, prioritizing in ambiguity and moving fast without losing control.

• Experience with procurement and P2P tooling (Omnea and NetSuite a plus).

• A bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, computer science, finance or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Bonus points if you have:
• Experience sourcing compute or cloud infrastructure: GPU capacity, hyperscaler commitments, data center or colocation.

• Experience in an AI/ML, cloud or infrastructure company.

• Experience operating under SOX or comparable internal-control frameworks.

• Experience contracting across multiple jurisdictions (Canada, US, UK, EU).

• Experience using AI tools to build and improve procurement workflows.

• A professional procurement certification (e.g., CIPS, CPSM).

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:
• A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

• Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

• RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

• 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

• Annual enrichment benefits:
Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

• 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

• Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:
• Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

• For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

• For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

• Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form , and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

About the Team
OpenAI’s Consumer Verticals team builds experiences that make ChatGPT more useful in the areas that matter to people every day. Within Travel, we’re exploring how AI can help people discover destinations, compare options, and plan trips around their preferences and needs.
Travel planning brings together inspiration, personal preferences, and practical constraints—from budgets and schedules to changing prices and availability. We aim to make that complexity easier to navigate, combining advanced AI capabilities, relevant travel information, and thoughtful product design to help people move from an idea to a trip with greater confidence.
We work closely with product, design, research, safety, privacy, and other ChatGPT teams to turn emerging AI capabilities into useful consumer experiences, with a high bar for quality, reliability, and user trust.

About the Role
We’re looking for a product-minded full stack software engineer to help shape the next generation of travel experiences in ChatGPT.
You will own features end-to-end, from early exploration and prototypes through launch and iteration. Your work will span intuitive interfaces, backend services, and integrations that connect conversational experiences with travel information and services.
This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy shaping new product areas, making complex information intuitive, and moving quickly from idea to production. Prior experience in AI or travel is not required.

In this role you will
• Build consumer travel experiences across ChatGPT’s web and mobile surfaces, with ownership spanning frontend interfaces, backend services, and external integrations.

• Translate travelers’ preferences and constraints into useful experiences for discovering destinations, comparing stays and transportation, and planning itineraries.

• Build integrations with travel data and services

• Partner with product, design, and research to turn AI capabilities into intuitive, personalized products and shape what to build next.

• Design reliable experiences that handle incomplete information, and service failures while giving users clear choices and control.

• Improve quality, performance, and usability through experimentation and user feedback, with privacy, safety, and user trust built into the product.

You might thrive in this role if you
• Have 10+ years of software engineering experience, with depth in full-stack development.

• Have shipped consumer products at scale and can own features across interfaces, APIs, services, and data flows.

• Bring strong product judgment and a high bar for craft, especially when making complex choices easy to understand.

• Enjoy shaping product direction and owning ambiguous problems from idea to production.

• Move quickly while making thoughtful tradeoffs around quality, reliability, and user trust.

• Are excited to apply AI to travel and help people turn their preferences and plans into useful next steps.

Bonus if you have
• Experience with AI-powered applications, conversational interfaces, or multimodal products.

• Experience building travel, marketplace, commerce including integrations with external providers.

• Experience with personalization, search and discovery, or systems that depend on frequently changing data.

• Experience with privacy-sensitive products, secure data flows, permissions, or user consent.

Okta’s Auth0 is an easy-to-implement authentication and authorization platform designed by developers for developers. The Enablement team is at the core of expanding Auth0's capabilities for B2B customers, enabling seamless and automated user lifecycle management at a massive scale. We build and own the critical features that enterprises rely on to connect their identity sources to Auth0, including Enterprise APIs and our powerful self-service capabilities .

Our work is highly impactful, helping customers automate the creation, updating, and deactivation of users. This is a cornerstone for B2B SaaS applications that need to efficiently manage access for their own customers and partners. We work with NodeJS , TypeScript , PostgreSQL , MongoDB , and React to build these highly available and scalable services.

• Help drive the architectural vision and strategy on the team to design and deliver powerful new enterprise APIs and functionality for our customers.

• Orchestrate and lead major technical projects across teams as necessary.

• Design, architect, code, and document large-scale distributed systems.

• Serve as a subject matter expert on building scalable, reliable, and maintainable distributed systems.

• Mentor and coach less experienced engineers on sound engineering practices and technical leadership.

• Collaborate with Product, Security, and other engineering teams to define and continually improve our platform and architecture.

• Drive technical decision-making while striving to hit the right balance between factors such as simplicity, flexibility, reliability, and performance.

• Participate in the team's on-call rotations to make sure we offer our customers the best availability for our services.

What you’ll bring to the role:

•

• 8+ years of experience working on large-scale systems or services.

• You bring solid architectural and security knowledge, backed by experience in designing, implementing, and evolving complex distributed systems.

• You have worked on projects that required close collaboration with external teams and have experience making those a success.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

The Data Intelligence & Analytics team at Cloudflare is responsible for building a centralized cloud data lake and an analytics platform that enables our internal Business Partners and Product teams with actionable insights and also provides a 360 view of our business. • Deep ML Expertise: Hands-on experience with tree models, neural nets, ranking, and especially LLM/VLM fine-tuning & RLHF/RLPF for ads.

• Communication Superpowers: Able to distill complex ML trade-offs for executives, product managers, and non-technical stakeholders alike.

• Prior work on ad creative tooling: Headline generators, image generators, pre-test models, editing flows for the advertiser.

As an Enablement Operations Manager at GitLab, you will run the operational engine behind global Enablement programs, events, and systems. You will turn program plans into clear timelines, logistics, communications, and repeatable processes so the field gets a consistent, well-run experience.

This role is hands-on with GitLab's largest Enablement-led events, including Revenue Kick-Off (RKO), GitLab Academy Bootcamps, President's Club (P-Club), and in-person workshops. You will also own Field Communications and the Enablement PMO and track how programs perform.

You will work closely with Enablement leaders and program owners, Revenue Operations, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Procurement, Workplace, and travel partners. This is a strong fit for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, calm under deadline pressure, and energized by making complex global programs run smoothly in an all-remote environment.

What You'll Do

• Own Field Communications for Enablement, including the communications calendar, field newsletters, Slack and email announcements, and launch messaging, so the field gets clear, timely, and consistent updates.

• Own the Enablement PMO, including program intake, the Enablement roadmap and calendar, prioritization inputs, project status tracking, and regular reporting to Enablement leadership.

• Track participation, attendance, completion, and event feedback, and prepare clear readouts for Enablement leadership and program owners.

• Keep standard operating procedures, planning documents, and handbook pages current so work is transparent and easy to hand off.

• Spot operational risks and friction early, escalate when needed, and recommend practical fixes that improve quality and speed.

• Strong project management skills: building plans, tracking dependencies, and driving follow-through with distributed stakeholders.

Who are we?
Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.
We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.
We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.
We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Role Overview

Ready to build AI agents that revolutionize enterprise security? The North Security team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to create autonomous systems that handle the complex, critical tasks security practitioners face every day.

Key Responsibilities

As a Senior Software Engineer focused on agentic security, you'll build intelligent systems that empower security teams. Your responsibilities will include:
• Build autonomous security agents that perform alert triage, secure code reviews, threat modeling, and vulnerability assessment

• Develop agent orchestration systems that help security practitioners automate repetitive security tasks

• Design and implement agent security controls to ensure our AI agents can safely interact with sensitive enterprise data

• Create the security infrastructure that allows agents to operate in high-trust environments with stringent deployment requirements

• Ship production-ready agent capabilities that run efficiently in resource-constrained environments

• Research and implement novel security patterns for AI agent systems, sometimes requiring custom solutions where standard libraries fall short

• Conduct security testing of both the agents you build and the platform that runs them.

Qualifications
• 5+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping user-facing security features

• Strong Python development skills with significant production experience

• Experience building or working with autonomous systems, AI agents, or intelligent automation

• Solid understanding of security principles including session management, authentication, authorization, and secure coding practices

• Ability to think about security at multiple layers: application security, agent behavior security, and infrastructure security

• Comfortable working across the full stack and diving into unfamiliar codebases to understand and fix issues

• Thrive in fast-paced environments where you can adapt to evolving priorities

• Excited about the intersection of AI/ML and security engineering.

Working Location
This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.
